messages:
Alex: PR ready -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/6712  
Sara: pinging oncall for quick review, this is causing a 5xx flood in us-west, customers seeing errors
Mike: oncall here, grabbing it now. can you paste the config diff?
Alex: pasted the minimal change below:
```yaml
kv_proxy:
  pool_size: 40 -> 24
  upstream_backoff_ms: 50 -> 200
  enable_rollback: true
```
Alex: short log snippet showing the spike:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:03Z] kv-proxy: upstream 503 x 120 in 30s
[2026-03-17T10:12:10Z] retries exhausted
```
Jia: quick Q — lowering pool_size could increase latency under normal load, any bench numbers?
Mike: ran a small perf run: p50 +8ms, p95 ~stable, but p99 during spike improved from ~720ms -> ~320ms
Jia: ok that tradeoff seems reasonable for stability. please canary it
Alex: added canary flag + rollout script in the PR, requesting quick approval + canary deploy
Deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for infra/pr-6712 in us-west1 (3/3 nodes)
Sam: I can watch the canary for 15m; if metrics look good I'll merge
Sara: can we suppress alert noise for the next 20m while canary runs? :thumbsup:
Mike: left one tiny review comment re: unit test coverage (non-blocking)
Alex: addressed the test nit, force-pushed the fix
Sam: can confirm canary healthy after 5m, no 503s, error rate trending down
Deploy-bot: Canary metrics: 503 rate down 92%, p95 latency stable
Alex: thanks — please merge when ready, noted rollback flag is present if needed
Sam: merged and tagged rollback-ready; monitoring dashboards are green so far
Oncall-bot: Incident check: error rate back to baseline, closing incident #2026-03-17-99
Alex: :party_parrot: Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround
